name: fintrack-pwa
description: Mobile-first personal finance PWA for accounts, transactions, debts, EMIs, and reports.

scripts.check:js: node --check js/app.js && node --check js/auth.js && node --check js/db.js && node --check js/calc.js && node --check js/firebase-config.js && node --check sw.js
scripts.check:json: python3 -m json.tool manifest.json >/tmp/fintrack-manifest.json.checked && python3 -m json.tool package.json >/tmp/fintrack-package.json.checked && python3 -m json.tool firestore.indexes.json >/tmp/fintrack-indexes.json.checked
scripts.check: npm run check:js && npm run check:json && npm test
